nodes.label: airrt-to-npu pass
nodes.description: Converts AIRRt to NPU SHIM DMA instruction sequence. Inserts trace-related NpuWrite32Op for tracing support.

nodes.label: Auto Trace Generation
nodes.description: Generates trace data for AIE compute tiles and memtiles using packet flow insertion in air-to-aie and NpuWrite32Op in airrt-to-npu.
